    How it works

    In Settings, enter your Tarkov Market API key and click Save. The key is hidden by default; use the eye icon to show or hide it.

    Choose a game mode: PVP, PVE or SEASON. If you have multiple characters, select one. Item prices use the game mode of the selected character.

    Name scanning always uses English. Use English item names in the game and open the item's Inspect window. With Automatic scanning enabled, the app checks the title after a left-click while the game is in the foreground. It does not scan item names without an Inspect window.

    After clicking Scan now, switch back to the game within 3 seconds and keep the item's Inspect window open. Manual scanning also works when Automatic scanning is off.

    To search by name, enter the item's English name and click Search. This does not require an open Inspect window or Automatic scanning.

    Flea Market shows Best price and 24-hour average price. Trader shows the best trader price. The price per slot appears in parentheses. Trader prices use the trader's own currency.

    Items Tracker appears when the selected character still has an active mandatory requirement for the item. The whole panel is hidden when no such item requirement remains.

    Stock shows the shared stock and the required quantity, for example 2/5. Found In Raid and Regular requirements appear on separate rows, but share the same stock.

    Click Add to increase the selected character's shared Tracked Items stock in the API by one item. Items are added only when you click the button.

    Completed quest and hideout requirements appear on separate rows, for example 4 items completed. These quantities indicate completion and do not increase stock.

    Text recognition runs locally on screenshots. The app does not read or modify the game's memory and does not send screenshots to external services. Item prices and data come from the Tarkov Market API.

    Closing either app window closes both windows.
